About Pawstcard

Pawstcard is a report-card tool for independent pet sitters and dog walkers. The idea: snap up to three photos on a visit, tap what happened, review the note it drafts, and send your client a link — a small postcard for every visit.

Pawstcard is in early access. The app is not released yet. You can join the waitlist on the home page and we will invite you to the beta.

What you stay in control of

  • The note is drafted from your photos and taps, and you can edit every word.
  • Nothing is sent until you approve it.
  • Medication entries use fixed wording instead of AI.

The Journal

The Journal is where we publish practical articles for independent pet sitters and dog walkers: contracts, invoices, visit notes and the everyday business of looking after other people's pets. It is general guidance, not professional advice — see our Terms of Use.
